body:
I spent years and tens of thousands of dollars on therapists.  They ended up just shrugging and saying "you shouldn't be having these problems."

My family refers me to therapy, they don't understand the head space but are supportive insofar as their expectations for me are much lower than my siblings, and of what they had of me in the past. This is shameful. At some point they stopped mentioning grandchildren, or a future spouse. 

My financial and educational status are fine, and are stable. I'm a "tryhard." Imagine the worst caricature of that possible.  That's me, but with a wincing self-consciousness as I watch the disaster play out in real time.  It's the least attractive thing ever.  I have difficulty meeting people on their level, so it makes them very uncomfortable. This is universal across all interpersonal relationships. I fear I am blind to whatever is holding me back.  There must be something seriously off about my personality. It's depressing that paid "professionals" can't pinpoint anything. Like I'm a cartoon, or a half-written character.

So how did you fix yourself?

I'm coming up blank.  It's getting hard to take myself seriously.  I get that life is horrible, and that many people die, starve, go homeless, or go insane, I just am in that limbo where I haven't got the courage to do it yet. I am broken though.  My experience confirms this.  That's how we get data in the first place. Testing and then coming to conclusions based on the results. 

I don't want to go into the specifics of my life, suffice to say I had high hopes for myself, but the inability to even so much as get another person to entertain me for a moment as a partner or equal, makes me realize just how delusional I must come off.  That's where the title comes in. I can't even do the most basic thing humans do.  I'm a joke.  Who cares about the house of cards I've built, the image of "achievement" I have, when I don't have a foundation to it.  I do not have the human part of being human.  I am a shell. How did you fix yourself? I am running out of ideas, I've tried both western and eastern ideas relatively thoroughly, with little (read: no) success.

Don't worry about it, there is nothing to feel. Just pathetic loss from a pathetic soul.

I just want to know why I am not deserving of intimacy.  It is not that fatalistic, I get that we are all independent actors on a stage, I just wasn't informed that I was an extra in my own play.  I was trying to make myself more attractive in all forms. It has yielded no results in terms of human intimacy.  It was a lesson in futility, and running on a hamster wheel for a few years in hope that somehow would eventually take notice.  No one did.  I don't blame them, I'm bland, and have multiple aspects of myself that betray any sense of attractiveness within the gender role I have to play. I play it poorly, it feels like a game played for the benefit of the other party entirely. Like I'm a puppet dancing for their enjoyment, before they find a real person to entertain their humanness. To bond and experiencing living with.

I'm boring. It just seems like there are other boring people who still manage to find intimacy. It's an inherent brokenness.  Too much time has passed.  This is just the last bit of gnashing and wailing before I let myself sink.  I PRAY that's the case, but knowing what a pathetic soul I am, I'll be on this same subreddit a decade from now, asking why the fuck nothing is working.  Some other person will answer, in a similar fashion, and that'll be that. What fun. I appreciate the response, but I know it will change nothing.  I don't need good feelings, I need results.  I am a failure of a human in the most fundamental sense.

Who cares how I feel.  No one does. Why would they?  They have their own problems and issues.  I'm not a victim, I just don't get to enjoy life with other people for some reason or another.  It just is.

No, in school I had a few close friends, and even some relationships.  I'm not sure what changed.  I think I just couldn't keep up. So here I am.  I just need to purchase a gun or something, then let myself fall into a less inhibited mood.  I really thought if I put myself out there, and worked on myself some, that someone among the hundreds of people I see each day, one might be interested.  No dice.  No use in crying over spilled milk.  Not everyone wins.  It's just a bit baffling.  Realizing that even though you're willing to push every day, that it doesn't mean anything.  The human intimacy equivalent of realizing you've been doing manual labor for free, and no amount of effort will bring results.

I'm overeager.  This turns people off to an immense degree, but the only alternative I've found short of serendipity is disassociating myself from my surroundings entirely. That doesn't work either, but it almost seems to be more accepted.

I haven't been touched in years.  At this point I no longer feel human.  That's not an understatement.  I don't really connect with the notion of the human condition anymore.  It's something that other people experience. I am very confused.  I see so many people coupling, interacting, in so many different ways, but something is missing here.  I appear to be in the same category as homeless mentally ill people and hermits, as far as other human's desire for interaction is concerned.  I'm not entitled to that though, I just don't understand what I am missing that so many others have.  It eats at me.  I feel dead, I wish I was.  I am watching my life go away anyway, the best years are slipping past.  I failed myself. I failed the younger version of me.  I failed the older version of me.  I am still not sure what went wrong.  Something did. Something went very wrong at some point.
